newsitem.title: ESTONIA: INKO BALTI PANK TO BECOME BOURSE MEMBER.
newsitem.headline: INKO BALTI PANK TO BECOME BOURSE MEMBER.

text.p: The Tallinn stock exchange board will on Monday discuss Inko Balti Pank's application to get bourse membership, Helo Meigas, bourse director told Reuters on Wednesday.
"The bank applied for bourse membership to start trading," Meigas said.
Some 27 percent of Inko Balti Pank shares are held by Ukrainian Inko Bank. Other shares are owned by individuals and companies.
The bank started in 1994 and is one of the smallest banks in Estonia with total assets at 144.3 million kroons as of first quarter.
